purpose: Requirements for DLID-based document references, link checking, path-fix and change-impact notices, inconsistency checks, and check output as counts plus a detail file.
summary: FR-007: formal references are reference-link definitions whose title holds a content hash and a DLID; inline links are not formal references
FR-009: link checks search the referenced directory and verify DLID, current path, relative path resolution, and fragment anchors (GitHub slug rules)
FR-010: path-fix notices give the old and confirmed current path, and fall back to documents in the current Index target list when the directory lacks the target
13.1: section IDs (DLIDs) are placed at the end of every heading and issued only by the DLID assignment operation
FR-013 to FR-015: change impact candidates are direct referrers whose recorded hash differs from the current hash, reported every time with no stored notification state
doc-link never rewrites links or hashes and never judges whether a referrer needs fixing; the project management AI does that after confirming with the user
FR-016: inconsistency check lists missing or duplicate IDs, broken references, path and fragment mismatches, ToC mismatches, and hash differences
Check results return counts and a detail file path on standard output, writing the detail file even for zero findings and reporting failure if it cannot be written
Acceptance conditions AC-003 to AC-035 cover path mismatch detection, impact listing, section scoping, directory search verification, and move target presentation
tasks: Implementing or modifying the check-links skill and its script
Implementing or modifying the check-impact change impact detection
Designing reference notation and DLID-bearing link titles in Markdown documents
Writing or reviewing design documents for references and impact notification
Implementing check output as counts and a detail file
Fixing broken or outdated links after documents are moved or renamed
Writing tests for link inspection and move-target detection
Updating content hashes in link titles after verifying referrers
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — 参照と変更通知
